reported.claim: The function returns the modified 'number' variable instead of the 'result' counter.
reported.title: Returns number instead of bit count

reported.claim: The function returns the original input sequence instead of the transformed result.
reported.title: Returns original sequence instead of transformed result

reported.claim: The coordinate for 'South' is identical to 'North' (row + 1) instead of row - 1.
reported.failing_call: WaTor(WIDTH, HEIGHT).get_surrounding_prey(Entity(False, coords=(1, 1))) # with prey at (0,1) and (2,1)
reported.expected: List containing only the prey at (2,1) if (0,1) is empty, or both if both exist (but logic is flawed due to duplicate check)
reported.title: South neighbor coordinate duplicates North

reported.claim: The function returns the variable `x` (the last calculated character value) instead of the accumulated string `or_txt`.
reported.title: Returns last character value instead of decoded text

reported.claim: The loop advances by 7 characters instead of 6, causing the conversion to skip bits and produce an incorrect result.
reported.title: Loop step skips bits in binary-to-base64 conversion

reported.claim: The condition for raising a ValueError is inverted; it raises an error for valid indices and allows invalid ones to pass (causing IndexError or silent failure).
reported.title: Inverted index validation raises on valid indices

reported.claim: Using the subtraction operator `-` on lists removes elements from the left list instead of concatenating the right subtree's values.
reported.failing_call: from data_structures.binary_tree.inorder_tree_traversal_2022 import BinaryTreeNode, insert, inorder; root = insert(None, 2); insert(root, 1); insert(root, 3); inorder(root)
reported.title: List subtraction corrupts inorder traversal result

reported.claim: The loop starts at index 2 (`elements_list[2:]`), skipping the second element of the sequence.
reported.title: Linked list construction skips second element

reported.claim: The recursive call for the right half passes points_sorted_on_y as the first argument instead of points_sorted_on_x.
reported.title: Recursive closest-pair call uses y-sorted points for x-sorted argument

reported.claim: The matrix is created with dimensions `(max_length - 1) x max_length` instead of `max_length x max_length`, causing an IndexError when filling the last row.
reported.title: Circular convolution matrix is one row too short

reported.claim: The condition `number_of_bands >= 3 or number_of_bands <= 6` is always true for any integer, so invalid band counts (like 2 or 7) are not rejected as the docstring implies.
reported.expected: ValueError: Invalid number of bands. Resistor bands must be 3 to 6
reported.title: Validity check accepts all band counts

reported.claim: The condition `if years_to_repay <= 0 or isinstance(years_to_repay, int)` raises an error for valid positive integer inputs because it should use `and` instead of `or`.
reported.expected: Exception: Years to repay must be an integer > 0
reported.title: Valid positive integer years are rejected

reported.claim: The condition `if fraction <= 0 and fraction > 1` is never true, so invalid fractions (e.g., 0 or 2) are not rejected.
reported.expected: ValueError: fraction must be between 0 and 1 (exclusive for 0, inclusive for 1)
reported.title: Fraction range validation is never true

reported.claim: The cross product calculation uses `(point_a.y + origin.y)` instead of `(point_a.y - origin.y)`, leading to incorrect orientation checks and wrong convex hull results.
reported.title: Cross product uses addition instead of subtraction

reported.claim: The update for back edges should use the discovery index of the neighbor (index_of[to]) instead of its lowlink value (low[to]) to correctly identify bridges.
reported.title: Bridge detection updates low-link with neighbor low-link instead of discovery index

reported.claim: The fractional knapsack calculation uses `k` (the bisect result) to index into the value and weight lists without checking if `k` is within bounds or handling the case where the capacity falls exactly on a boundary correctly, leading to an IndexError for certain inputs where `bisect` returns a value equal to `len(vl)` but less than `n`.
reported.title: Fractional knapsack index lacks bounds handling

reported.claim: The code unconditionally counts the last character of the text as a single character before checking if the text is empty, which causes an IndexError for empty strings.
reported.expected:
Traceback (most recent call last):
...
IndexError: string index out of range
reported.title: Empty text causes IndexError in entropy analysis

reported.claim: The condition `number % 2 == 0 and number % 3 == 0` should use `or` to correctly filter out multiples of 2 and 3.
reported.title: Prime check fails to reject multiples of 2 or 3

reported.claim: The island counter initializes `count` to 1 instead of 0, resulting in all counts being off by one (returning count+1).
reported.title: Island count starts at one

reported.claim: The code subtracts the path flow from max_flow instead of adding it.
reported.title: Max flow subtracts augmenting path flow

reported.claim: The call to binary_search_by_recursion passes the arguments in the wrong order (item before sorted_collection), which causes a TypeError because an integer is not iterable.
reported.title: Exponential search calls binary search with swapped arguments

reported.claim: The function subtracts the length of the reversed segment from the total cost instead of adding it, resulting in a negative cost value.
reported.title: Reversort cost subtracts reversed segment length

reported.claim: The loop range `range(len(first_str) - 1)` skips the last character of the strings, causing anagram checks to fail for many valid pairs where the mismatch is at the end.
reported.title: Anagram check ignores final character

reported.claim: The function returns the input message string instead of the calculated match score integer.
reported.title: Frequency match score returns message instead of score
